intro: Clean, modern, and built to last, our Dinex dining table combines bold design with practical durability, perfect for your daily meals and family moments.

features.title: Modern and durable
features.text: Crafted for contemporary homes, this table’s sleek profile and tough build make it your stylish and functional centerpiece.

features.title: Glossy and guarded
features.text: A high-gloss, scratch-resistant MDF top stands up to spills, scuffs, and heat—while keeping its polished finish intact.

features.title: Protected wood grain finish
features.text: Moisture-resistant surface with a rich wood grain look adds warmth while staying easy to clean and maintain.

features.title: Built for strength
features.text: Black powder-coated steel legs provide a stable base and bold contrast—keeping the table firm through every meal.

features.title: Comfort without clutter
features.text: Thoughtfully designed leg spacing ensures generous room to stretch and seat six with ease and stability.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
